mapper.select: select count(*) from tasks where owner_id = #{ownerId} and status <> 'DONE'
select * from tasks where owner_id = #{ownerId} and status <> 'DONE'

select id, owner_id, title, description, due_date_time, importance, urgency, estimated_minutes, status, category, created_at, updated_at from tasks where owner_id = #{ownerId} and status <> 'DONE' and due_date_time < current_timestamp order by due_date_time asc, importance desc, urgency desc, updated_at desc limit #{limit}
select id, owner_id, title, description, due_date_time, importance, urgency, estimated_minutes, status, category, created_at, updated_at from tasks where id = #{taskId} and owner_id = #{ownerId}
select distinct category from tasks where owner_id = #{ownerId} and category is not null and category <> '' order by category
mapper.insert: insert into tasks ( owner_id, title, description, due_date_time, importance, urgency, estimated_minutes, status, category, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{ownerId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{dueDateTime}, #{importance}, #{urgency}, #{estimatedMinutes}, #{status}, #{category}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update tasks set title = #{title}, description = #{description}, due_date_time = #{dueDateTime}, importance = #{importance}, urgency = #{urgency}, estimated_minutes = #{estimatedMinutes}, status = #{status}, category = #{category}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and owner_id = #{ownerId}
